facts.text: Isaac's top speed is about 8.8 px/update at speed 1.0 and about 11 at speed 2 (correction: the first reading gave 2.07, missing the hidden square root in the friction).

Per movement step: input scale k = 0.75 + 0.25 x MoveSpeed; sideways velocity x0.894; accel +0.6 x k; friction x0.880 per step (x0.775 per update if the step runs twice); no hard speed cap on a normal floor.
After a hit Isaac is invulnerable for 60 updates (2 s) for a half-heart hit and 120 (4 s) for a full heart or more.
A normal hit gives Isaac no knockback; he only feels the separation of two solid bodies.
A feared NPC flees for about 1.4 s after Isaac backs off beyond 250 px (170 px behind cover); threat check every 14 updates.

Modes 2, 4 and 5 fly at x1.2 speed and inherit 0.4 x the shooter's velocity (Dingle mode 2 is 12.0 and 10.8; Haunt spit about 12).
Boss burst (FireBossProjectiles) with a target: speed 3.5-10.5 within +/-30 degrees of the target line; with target (0,0): a random direction at speed exactly 7; no x1.2.

A shot hurts Isaac only if its height is at or above -50 x s (s = his sprite scale 0.5-1.0); shots higher than 50 pass over him; a shot spawned that high has collision class 0. A shot always dies on contact.
Shot damage is 1 (2 if scale over 1.15) unless set; flight: falling speed = 0.9 x falling speed + 0.1 + accel; dies when height goes above -5 or it hits a rock below 50 px.
Can-shoot gate: no shot unless Isaac is within range with a clear line (Gemini's baby 300, Pooter 200, Haunt/Charger/Hopper 1000); false while confused or feared.
Target position is Isaac's current position, no lead (confused: a random point up to about 240 px away re-rolled every 15 updates; feared: away from Isaac).
Path chase: straight at the target within 70 px with a clear line, otherwise grid steps; far from its target the steady speed is about 6.7 x its speed factor.
Enemy physics: velocity x friction, then position += speedMultiplier x velocity; a push a with friction f gives a steady speed a / (1 - f).
